sections.heading: Pre-release notice
paragraphs: This is the interim privacy notice for the pre-release password accounts of {brand}. It has not been reviewed by counsel and will be replaced before launch.

sections.heading: What a password account stores
paragraphs: A password hash. The password itself is never stored by us; it is checked and hashed by the sign-in provider.
An age confirmation of 18 or older (stored as the bracket 18p), the version of the terms you accepted, and the time you accepted them.
No game progress, saves, location or device data is attached to a password account.

sections.heading: Diagnostics and gameplay analytics
paragraphs: The game can send diagnostics (errors, device class, graphics tier and performance numbers) and gameplay analytics (which pages and modes are opened). Each is a separate switch on the terms screen and in Settings, and both are on by default. Turning one off drops its events on your device before they are sent.

Events carry registry names and small numbers only: no name, no free text, no save data and no date of birth. Nothing is sent before you accept the terms, and nothing is sent from a device blocked by the age check. The age check keeps one flag on your device and nothing on our servers.

sections.heading: Who processes it
paragraphs: Accounts are held by Supabase Auth, which acts as our processor. Our servers talk to it on your behalf; your browser does not call it directly.

Our servers see the network address of each request only long enough to limit abuse. The address is reduced to a hashed network prefix with a daily changing salt, and the address itself is not stored or logged.

sections.heading: Cookies and storage
paragraphs: Signing in sets one cookie, dv-rt, that keeps you signed in for up to 30 days. It is HttpOnly, so scripts on the page cannot read it, and it is only sent to the sign-in routes of this service.
The access token stays in the memory of the account page and is gone when you close it.

sections.heading: Deleting your account
paragraphs: While the self-service route is available, the account page can delete your account after you type your username to confirm. The account and its stored record are removed.

sections.heading: Getting a copy of your data
paragraphs: While the self-service route is available, the account page can export your username, age bracket, terms version and acceptance time.

sections.heading: How we answer requests
paragraphs: We verify a request with your username and password at the service while the self-service routes are available. If they are not, we use a manual check with you at {contact}.
We answer each request within 30 days of receiving it.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Deletion and access requests, and any privacy question: {contact}.
